gloss: in one go, all at once, in a single breath

definitions.gloss: in one go, all at once
definitions.explanation: Doing something completely without stopping or in a single continuous action.
Drinking an entire beverage in one continuous action.

examples.japanese: {一気|いっき}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{読|よ}んだ→読む：00426_yomu⟧。
examples.english: I read it all in one go.

examples.japanese: ⟦{階段|かいだん}→階段：00782_kaidan⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{一気|いっき}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{駆|か}け{上|あ}がった→駆け上がる：06110_kakeagaru⟧。
examples.english: I ran up the stairs all at once.

examples.japanese: ⟦{問題|もんだい}→問題：00797_mondai⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{一気|いっき}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{解決|かいけつ}した→解決する：17191_kaiketsusuru⟧。
examples.english: I solved the problem all at once.

examples.japanese: ⟦ビール→ビール：01015_biiru⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{一気|いっき}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{飲|の}んだ→飲む：00322_nomu⟧。
{一気|いっき}⟦{飲|の}み→飲む：00322_nomu⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{危険|きけん}→危険：01141_kiken⟧だ。
{一気|いっき}コール⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{禁止|きんし}→禁止：02643_kinshi⟧⟦されている→する：00392_suru⟧。

notes:
{一気|いっき} means doing something in one continuous action without pause.

COMMON PATTERNS (Sense 1):
- {一気|いっき}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧: in one go, all at once
- {一気|いっき}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{読|よ}む→読む：00426_yomu⟧: to read in one sitting
- {一気|いっき}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{書|か}く→書く：00477_kaku⟧: to write in one sitting
- {一気|いっき}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{片付|かたづ}ける→片付ける：01192_katazukeru⟧: to finish all at once
- {一気|いっき}{呵成|かせい}: at one stretch (literary)

DRINKING CONTEXT (Sense 2):
- {一気|いっき}⟦{飲|の}み→飲む：00322_nomu⟧: chugging
- {一気|いっき}コール: chanting to encourage chugging
- This practice is discouraged due to health risks

Note: In recent years, many universities have banned {一気|いっき}⟦{飲|の}み→飲む：00322_nomu⟧} due to alcohol-related accidents.
